title: A1 sidecar: A2's inputs carried out of the bi_facts contract
description: What a parser knows about each usage unit that is not a fact about the model: the aggregation chosen at the use site per measure (a field placed on a shelf, where the tool chooses the aggregation there) and the visuals beside it on its page. Also which PUBLISHED datasources were resolved against a .tds beside the workbook and which resolved to nothing. A parser emits these as `_aggregations`, `_siblings`, `_resolved_published` and `_unresolved_published`; A1 pops them out of bi_facts and writes them here.

aggregations.description: measure name -> the aggregation at the use site.

siblings.description: Titles of the other visuals on the same page; null where the parser does not record them.
